children.value: > Fact From Story Martin Scorsese has put his knowledge of internet slang to the test in a new TikTok challenge posted by none other than his daughter, Francesca Scorsese.

> > Fact From Story In a TikTok posted by Francesca on Thursday 5 October, the father-daughter duo appeared on camera while the legendary director’s daughter explained that she was going to quiz him on popular internet slang.
> > > Fact From Story Francesca told her father, 80, that she was going to quiz him on popular internet slang.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Internet slang is constantly evolving.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Quizzes are a common way to test someone's knowledge.
> Commonsense Knowledge People often test each other on their knowledge of current trends.
